text:
Alex P: Hey all — trying to pull up a single dashboard that shows per-region model health (latency / error rates / capacity) across hosted + dedicated. Anyone have a direct Grafana link or should I use the Console? :wave:
Maria G: We do have a board called 'Models — Region Overview'. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/8a7f2/models-region-overview?orgId=1 :eyes:
Alex P: I get a 403 when opening it — "You need permission to view this dashboard" :lock:. Might be a role issue.
Jamal K: OpsBot: note — dashboards require the stack:observability:view role. Who do you want me to loop in for access?
Alex P: Can someone grant view for team eng-platform? I need to check p95 before a deploy in ~90m.
Maria G: @Jamal K can you request eng-platform -> observability view in IAM? I don't have org-level perms to add teams. Also if you only need latency + errors, I can add a short read-only shortcut on the Console.
Jamal K: Filed access request with Infra IAM. Ticket INC-8427. ETA ~45m for role grant. I'll update here when it's done.
Alex P: Thanks. In the meantime — where do traces for inference errors live? Want to correlate a spike in errors to any backend traces.
Maria G: Traces are in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.internal/search. Try filter: service=\"model-serving\" tag.region=us-east-1 and narrow to the error timeframe.
Alex P: Perfect. Any quick Grafana query for p95 latency across all models by region?
Maria G: Paste into Explore as a PromQL expression:
```
sum by(model, region) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(serving_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region)))
```
That should return p95 tokens/sec latency exportable across regions.
Jamal K: FYI I just tuned the staging alert 'model_high_error_rate' to reduce noise — will validate and push to prod after one deploy cycle. @Alex P you may see a couple noisy alerts while we validate.
Alex P: Cool — please ping when prod is updated so I can re-run the SLO check. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Deploy bot: Change request INC-8427 updated with comment 'grant eng-platform observability view'.
Maria G: If access still fails after IAM update, ping infra-iam@redwood and include the grafana link and the user list.
Alex P: Will do. Thanks everyone.
